parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain to query.

You can query one or more domain names. To query multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).

If you do not specify this parameter, the service returns the merged data for all streaming domains
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的主播流域名。
支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You can query data from the last 90 days.

The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If you leave this parameter empty, the service queries data from the last 24 hours by default
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 最多可获取最近90天的数据。 最小数据粒度为5分钟，取值为空则默认获取最近24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

logo: logo detection
